fact: The Ministry of Education is implementing two World Bank AI pilots: an AI Teacher Coach Programme for Primary 5 and 6 teachers in six schools and an AI Student Tutor Programme for Secondary 3 Mathematics and Geography in four schools (State House).

fact: The Seychelles Ministry of Education says it is already advancing education initiatives that incorporate AI, including Smart Classroom, Teacher Coach and Student Tutor, to be scaled under its 2026-2030 AI in Education Framework.
The Ministry of Education, with the World Bank, launched the AI Teacher Coach and AI Student Tutor pilots, introduced at a workshop for educators from six named primary schools.
